presentation.label: IMPROVED ENVELOPES
presentation.summary: The AMP envelope reworked: HOLD runs from no hold to AUTO, ATK, HOLD and DEC/REL have fine steps from 0.2 ms, ENV RESET gains AMP, and the envelope knobs show times.
presentation.overview: Envelopes reworks the AMP envelope. HOLD runs from 0 (no hold: the decay starts the moment the attack reaches the top) up to AUTO at the top of the knob (hold while the note lasts); a hold never cuts the attack short. AMP ATK and FILTER ATK step 0.2 ms at a time up to 5 ms, 0.5 ms up to 15 ms, then about 10 % a step up to 30 s. SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET gains AMP and AMP+FILT (from Env Reset Amp): sequenced trigs and retrig rolls restart the amp envelope from silence after a short pre-fade; a pad or MIDI hit itself, and the first trig after PLAY, continue from the current level, as stock. AMP ATK, HLD and DEC and FILTER ATK, DEC and REL show times instead of 0..127.
highlights: HOLD: 0 = no hold, top = AUTO; never cuts the attack.
AMP and FILTER ATK: 0.2 ms steps at the low end.
ENV RESET AMP with a click-free pre-fade.
Envelope knobs show ms and s.
usage: Press AMP. Turn DEC down: the knob shows its time to -60 dB, in 0.2 ms steps below 5 ms.
Turn HLD to 0: the decay starts as soon as the attack peaks. Turn it up for a hold in ms, or to the top for AUTO (decay from note-off).
Hold FUNC and turn HLD: it jumps between 0, 125 ms and AUTO.
On the FILTER page, ATK, DEC and REL show their times on the same fine curves.
In SOUND SETTINGS, set ENV RESET to AMP: sequenced trigs and retrig rolls restart the amp envelope from silence.

access.location: AMP page (HLD, ATK); SOUND menu (FUNC + MUTE) > SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET.
steps: Turn HLD or ATK; FUNC + turn on HLD jumps between 0, 125 ms and AUTO.

controls.name: AMP > HLD
controls.doc: 0 no hold, then 0.67 ms steps to 10 ms, 1.3 ms to 18 ms, 3.3 ms to 51 ms, 6.7 ms to 151 ms, 13 ms to 298 ms, about 6 % a step to 15.5 s, AUTO at the top. The decay never starts before the attack peaks.

controls.name: AMP > ATK
controls.doc: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms steps to 15 ms, then about 10 % a step to 30 s.

controls.name: FILTER > ATK
controls.doc: The same curve as AMP ATK: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms steps to 15 ms, then about 10 % a step to 30 s.

controls.name: AMP > DEC, FILTER > DEC and REL
controls.doc: 0 instant, 0.2 ms steps to 5 ms, 0.5 ms to 15 ms, 1 ms to 25 ms, 2.5 ms to 50 ms, 5 ms to 100 ms, 10 ms to 200 ms, 25 ms to 300 ms, then about 14 % a step to 40-45 s. Times are to -60 dB. AMP DEC at the top stays INF.

controls.name: SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET
controls.doc: Steps OFF, AMP, FILTER, AMP+FILT. With AMP, sequenced trigs and retrig rolls (a held pad's RTRG too) restart the amp envelope from silence after a short pre-fade; a pad or MIDI hit itself, and the first trig after PLAY, continue from the current level, as stock.

limitations: Saved HLD, ATK, DEC and REL values read differently from stock: HLD 0 is no hold instead of AUTO, 127 is AUTO instead of 16 s, and HLD, AMP and FILTER ATK, DEC and REL follow the new curves.
Times shown are calibrated to one Rytm MKII (AMP attack 0.957x, decay 0.918x; the filter envelope runs at the OS model's speed); another unit may differ slightly.

ENV RESET AMP acts only on trigs the Rytm schedules in time (sequencer trigs, retrig rolls): a pad or MIDI hit itself and the first trig after PLAY play as stock, and a roll faster than about 8 ms may not fade fully to silence.
